``` {r eval = FALSE}
library(sf)
# --- load polygon data --- #
munip_path <- system.file("extdata", "areas", "munip_vallecauca.gpkg",
                          package = "clim4health")
munip <- read_sf(munip_path)

# --- aggregate to municipalities --- #
hind <- c4h_space(hind, munip, fun = "mean", areas_id = "munip_code")
fcst <- c4h_space(fcst, munip, fun = "mean", areas_id = "munip_code")

# --- calibrate predictions for all municipalities --- #
hind_cal <- c4h_downscale("Intbc", exp = hind, obs = rean,
                          method_bc = "quantile_mapping",
                          method_remap = "con")
fcst_cal <- c4h_downscale("Intbc", exp = hind, obs = rean, exp_cor = fcst,
                          method_bc = "quantile_mapping",
                          method_remap = "con")
```
